heard: What misery is mine, gathering fruit after harvest Like cleaning the vineyard when the grapes are gone Not a cluster left to eat, not one early fig The faithful have vanished from the land entirely Not one upright person remains among us They all lie in wait for blood in the dark Each one haunts his own brother with a net Both hands are skilled at weaving evil tight The official demands his place, the judge takes his bribe The powerful dictate what they want to do The best is like a bribe
